__broaden__.αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’) · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (οἶδα καὶ αὐτή ’I know it myself’)
__broaden__.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’) · also in agreement with an unexpressed ’you’: ’you yourselves’ (αὐτοὶ δ’ ὀτρύνεσθε ’and you yourselves rouse yourselves’)
__broaden__.δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’ · also + gen.: ’through, through the midst of’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’)
__broaden__.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
__broaden__.εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’
__broaden__.εἶδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg. (εἶδον ’I saw’) · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they saw’
__broaden__.εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ηὗρον) · also aor. 1 sg.: ’I found’ (εὗρον ἔπειτ’ … ἑταίρους)
__broaden__.ἐλέαιρε: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’pity!’ · also impf. 3 sg.: ’she pitied’ (θεὰ δ’ ἐλέαιρε)
__broaden__.ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’) · also ’were born’ (ἠδ’ ἐγένοντο)
__broaden__.ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; leave off, give up; fut. 1 pl., used hortatively: ’let us leave off’ · also with an object, ’we will let (him) be’ (τοῦτον μὲν ἐάσομεν)
__broaden__.ἔφυν: φύω — grow; intransitive root aor. 3 pl. (a poetic 3 pl. in -ν, identical to the 1 sg.): ’they had grown’ · also ’clung, grew fast’ (ἔφυν τ’ ἐν χερσὶν ’clung in my hands’)
__broaden__.ἔχουσ: ἔχω — have, hold, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσι) · or fem. nom. pl. part. ἔχουσαι · also fem. nom. sg. part., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσα): ’holding’ (ῥάβδον ἔχουσ’)
__broaden__.ἱεροῖς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. dat. pl., agreeing with βωμοῖς · also neut. dat. pl., agreeing with δώμασι: ’sacred (halls)’ (ἱεροῖς ἐν δώμασι)
__broaden__.ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also attributive, agreeing with δώματα: ’sacred (halls)’ (ἱερὰ πρὸς δώματα)
__broaden__.μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα)
__broaden__.τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’)
__broaden__.πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’)
__broaden__.προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’) · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they addressed’ (ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδων)
__broaden__.φάρμακον: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or deadly); acc. sg. · also nom. sg., subject: ’the drug’ (φάρμακον οὐλόμενον … ἔφυσε)
__broaden__.ἁδινὸν: ἁδινός — thick, close-packed, crowded; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, of weeping: ’in a thick flood, heavily’ · also of lowing cattle: ’heavily’ (ἁδινὸν μυκώμεναι)
__broaden__.οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’ · also correlative ’such as, as’ (οἷον ὅτε πρώτιστον ’such as when first’)
__broaden__.ἀνήιον: ἄνειμι — go up; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνῄειν): ’I went up’ · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they went up’ (παρὰ νηὸς ἀνήιον)
__broaden__.ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’)
__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’)
